 Orlando Magic The Orlando Magic play the Toronto Raptors twice this week in back-to-back games.

 Franz Wagner, Anthony Black, Wendell Carter Jr. and Desmond Bane are the four players to watch with this. Black had a great first game back. He showed an ability to take over against the Knicks in the fourth quarter.
